color-no-hex.message: Hardcoded hex colors are only allowed in web/src/styles/tokens/palette.css — add a token there and reference it with var() instead. See docs/design-system.md.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use color-mix(in srgb, var(--token) N%, transparent) against a palette token instead of rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() literals — keeps every color traceable to tokens/palette.css.

overrides.comment: palette.css is the only file allowed to originate a raw color value.
